Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the task. The question asks which director was born *earlier* (i.e., has the lower birth year). The Planner found that Eduardo Morera was born in 1906 and José Luis Garci was born in 1944. Since 1906 is earlier than 1944, the director of *Idols Of The Radio* (Morera) was born earlier. However, the Planner concluded that "Solos en la madrugada" (Garci) was the answer, stating "José Luis Garci (born 1944) is older at release... so Solos en la madrugada is the film whose director was born earlier." This logic is flawed; being born in 1944 means being born later, not earlier. The Planner confused "born earlier" with "older at the time of release" or simply made a logical reversal error in the final comparison.
